_comment: Photo maps used by the simulator (Solar System Scope, CC BY 4.0 — see CREDITS.md). 2K maps load when a planet is first seen up close; the 4K/8K files only on close approach with the Medium/High quality preset, and are released when you leave. Deliberately NOT listed: the *_fictional dwarf-planet maps (invented surfaces), the .tif normal/specular maps (browsers can't load TIFF), 2k/8k_stars*.jpg (the sky is drawn from the Yale Bright Star Catalogue + a procedural Milky Way) and the Saturn ring alpha maps (rings are built from measured ring data).
